messages:
Priya (CS): quick weekly account-health check for AcmeCorp. noticed model-mix shift after last canary — rw-chat-7b-v2 adoption jumped to 38% of calls (was 9% W-o-W). usage: tokens/day -8% (70k -> 64k), spend flat, but p95 latency for rw-chat-7b-v2 is +120ms vs baseline, and fallback rate to rw-chat-7b-quant is 4.6% (0.6% before). thoughts?
Alex (AE): big adoption jump — thanks for flagging. renewal talk next month, want to avoid perception of instability.
Marco (SRE): saw correlated 5xx spike between 03:12-03:18 UTC on dedicated pool A. digging. kv-cache miss rate increased ~3x. pushing a quick fix: reduce TTL on prefix cache to 30s for that pool.
Priya (CS): thanks Marco. can we get a short RCA and mitigation steps for the customer-facing note? they asked why model responses slowed.
Marco (SRE): putting notes here. logs:
```
[03:14:22] poolA | warn | kv-cache miss for key shard-17
[03:14:22] poolA | err  | fallback invoked -> rw-chat-7b-quant
[03:15:01] poolA | info | fallback rate spike 4.2%
```
Marco (SRE): early hypothesis: new model variant has larger KV working set -> cache churn. rolling back quick config to restrict concurrent inflight to 6 per GPU reduces p95 by ~80ms in local test.
Tina (PM): definitely want a canary rollback plan + clear messaging. Priya, can your AE sync include the rollback+timeline? we'll also recommend a guided prompt set to smooth token distribution.
Priya (CS): will do. action items: 1) Marco — short RCA + rollback playbook (ETA today EOD). 2) Marco/Tina — propose canary throttle (limit adopt ramp to +10%/24h). 3) Alex — prep renewal note emphasizing canary controls and SLA. 4) Ops-bot — create ticket #ACME-1123 and ping when RCA posted.
ops-bot: ticket ACME-1123 created: "AcmeCorp model mix latency/fallback investigation" link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ACME-1123
Alex (AE): I'll draft a 1-pager for the customer. Priya — can you confirm ask for a short joint call tomorrow? :calendar:
Priya (CS): yes — propose 11am PT. thanks all :thumbsup:
